scope.source_scope: Entire original S003 frozen normative capture; unchanged full brief and Viewer plan; all material current assertions including novel findings, summaries, dispositions, absences, unresolved claims, proposals and unavoidable method cues.
scope.key_role: Non-exhaustive omission aid; every reported factual claim independently compared with S003.

E01.context: This/latest/editor URI is /0.5/; editor-draft data not necessarily supported.

E02.quote: Implementations may be expected (MUST) or encouraged (SHOULD) to support the reading of the data
E02.context: A general description of possible transitional reading obligations, not a blanket requirement to implement every transitional feature.

E03.quote: comments MUST NOT be included in JSON objects.

E04.context: All Zarr features may be used unless expressly disallowed; feature permission is distinct from mandatory support by every reader.

E05.quote: unless explicitly disallowed in this specification.
E05.context: Permission includes codecs, chunk grids, key encodings, data types, storage transformers. No universal reader-codec support promise is stated.

E06.quote: represented here as it would appear locally but could equally be stored on a web server
E06.context: Image rank is 2-5; axis names are arbitrary.

E07.quote: The name of the array is arbitrary with the ordering defined by
E07.context: Illustrated image/labels hierarchy; label dimensions same or 1 appears in diagram comment, not an independent MUST.

E08.quote: Three groups MUST be defined above the images:
E08.context: Well, row and plate; well/plate implement their specs. Empty row/well groups SHOULD NOT exist.

E09.context: OME metadata in hierarchy zarr.json; version string in ome namespace and consistent within hierarchy.

E10.quote: The values MUST be unique across all "name" fields.
E10.context: Axis name mandatory; type SHOULD and custom string types MAY. Valid custom types do not guarantee a particular reader can render them.

E11.context: Recommended UDUNITS-2 strings; absent unit does not establish dimensionless physical coordinates.

E12.quote: MUST match the names in the "axes" metadata.
E12.context: Axis-list length equals image array rank; multiscale-array dimension_names mandatory and matches axes.

E13.quote: bioformats2raw internally introduced a wrapping layer.
E13.context: Transitional multi-image layout and typical collection hierarchy, not a survey of readers.

E14.context: Normative prose quotes the value; JSON examples use numeric 3. Plate metadata takes precedence when top-level represents plate; image collections cannot be mixed with plates.

E15.quote: If the "series" attribute does not exist and no "plate" is present:
E15.context: Then consecutively numbered groups starting 0; series optional list of string paths ordered as XML Images if XML supplied; XML SHOULD exist and uses MetadataOnly if present.

E16.quote: SHOULD make users aware of the presence of more than one image
E16.context: MAY show all images or offer choice; MAY use series and ignore extraneous groups. Awareness SHOULD does not require showing all images.

E17.quote: The transformations in the list are applied sequentially and in order.
E17.context: General transform types include identity default, translation, scale; vectors may be inline or stored via path.

E18.context: 2-5 dimensional multiscale; optional one time and one channel/null/custom. Axis order corresponds array order and time, channel/custom, space. Anisotropic zyx is SHOULD.

E19.quote: relative to the current zarr group.
E19.context: datasets required; path required, group-relative, largest/highest-resolution to smallest; dimensionality and order equal axes.

E20.quote: They MUST contain exactly one scale transformation
E20.context: Only scale and translation; scale physical size/duration or relative factor when physical scale unavailable/applicable. Optional exactly-one translation follows scale; vectors match axes.

E21.quote: If scaling information is not available or applicable for one of the axes
E21.context: Relative-to-first-level factor required in this case, 1 when no downsampling. Relative values alone do not prove physical calibration.

E22.context: Optional multiscale-level transform follows dataset transforms, subject to same type/order rules; name,type,metadata SHOULD fields.

E23.quote: Or perhaps choose based on chunk size.
E23.context: Name matching and first fallback are selection guidance with pseudocode and an explicit alternative; adopting a first-fallback policy is permitted, but exclusive mandatory reader behavior is not established.

E24.context: Example contains channel label/active/coefficient/family/inverted and rdefs defaultT/defaultZ/model; their guaranteed presence not stated by normative requirements.

E25.quote: The "omero" metadata is optional, but if present it MUST contain the field "channels"
E25.context: Each channel color six RGB hex digits and window min/max/start/end; no normative channel-list size equality sentence in capture.

E26.quote: usually having the same dimensions and coordinate transformations
E26.context: Descriptive normative prose says corresponding label image same coordinate system in segmentation case; usually qualifies dimensions/transforms. It is not marked non-normative merely because it says usually.

E27.quote: [uint8, int8, uint16, int16, uint32, int32, uint64, int64].
E27.context: Nested labels group, arbitrary label names, permitted metadata-free intermediate groups, declared labels paths; complete listing SHOULD.

E28.quote: MUST have the same number of entries (scale levels) as the original unlabeled image.
E28.context: Label multiscales required; image-label object and colors/version SHOULD, required types if present.

E29.quote: MUST be the integer corresponding to a particular label.
E29.context: colors entries keyed by label-value; rgba MAY, four integer 0-255 values if present; readers SHOULD use specified colors, not mandatory universal palette.

E30.quote: a string specifying the relative path to a Zarr image group.
E30.context: Optional properties objects keyed by integer label-value; optional source.image relative reference, default ../../ because usual nesting. Correct resolution depends on label-group location.

E31.context: Example [0,0,128,128]; not evidence of actual viewer execution.

E32.quote: greater than or equal to 0 within the context of the plate
E32.context: Optional acquisitions list; unique integer ID required. Acquisition name/maximumfieldcount SHOULD; description/start/end MAY with required types.

E33.context: All physical rows/columns defined even empty; alphanumeric case-sensitive unique names, avoid case-insensitive collisions SHOULD; required columns/rows/version/wells; row/column paths and indices agree.

E34.context: Sparse example one acquisition/one field per well; larger grid does not imply all well subgroups populated.

E35.quote: specifying all fields of views for a given well.
E35.context: well.images list required; fields use unique alphanumeric case-sensitive paths. Each image acquisition ID required if multiple acquisitions and matches plate definition; well version SHOULD.

E36.context: No reader implementation catalog in capture; bioformats2raw named elsewhere as writer. This edition /0.5/, latest /latest/ also appears in citing section.

E37.quote: Clarify that the dimension_names field in axes MUST be included.
E37.context: 0.5.2 clarification,0.5.1 omero,0.5.0 Zarr v3; pre-0.5 axes/types/transforms/separator history.

E38.quote: All of the text of this specification is normative except sections explicitly marked as non-normative, examples, and notes.
E38.context: Requirements descriptive and RFC2119; lowercase keywords can carry force. Usually is a qualifier, not an automatic informative marker.

B01.context: Read-only local viewer; discovery, multiresolution axes navigation, associated labels, calibrated coordinates, responsiveness and truthful display limits. Research actual readers broadly; distinguish format obligations, optional capabilities and product decisions.

P01.quote: time-point and plane selection where relevant
P01.context: Image listing, pan/zoom, conditional channel/time/plane controls, optional associated overlays, dimensions/units/coordinates, level choice; detailed metadata rules absent.

P02.quote: Source files remain unchanged; display settings are local to the viewing session.
P02.context: Background reads/cancellation, understandable failures, real tools interoperability, additional capability choices explicit review, calibration/alignment/responsiveness acceptance. No concrete fixtures.

I01.quote: Fixed admitted source S003 only; no live fetching for this component case.
I01.context: The base stage and all manifest pins match. Explicit current addendum positively requires decisions/V001.json despite an empty base-stage companion list. Catalog/config hashes are metadata, not operation proof.

E39.quote: Multi-word keys in this specification should use the camelCase style.
E39.context: The recommendation concerns specification keys, with existing exceptions; no requirement for viewer-private session-store keys.

material_claims.claim: Fixed case, 896-line S003 /0.5/ capture, full brief and thin plan are identified; two groups organize the whole requested scope.
material_claims.rationale: Admitted source and scope identities match. Task-card and seed metadata are unavoidable current cues, not independent phase-1 authority. Two-group organization is valid but does not establish assignment history.

material_claims.claim: Every MUST/SHOULD/MAY in the report is the source’s own; obligation, recommendation, option and product decision are distinguished.
material_claims.rationale: The vocabulary is useful, but label-listing, image-label version presence, reader rendering and private-store naming below exceed source force. The blanket source-own claim is false for current substantive assertions.

material_claims.claim: No fetch/code/test/input writes; full fresh source/brief/plan/seed/TASK reads, probe failures, seed verification and acquisition records are claimed.
material_claims.rationale: Acquisition, seed, TASK, tools and history remain locked. Current hashes do not establish candidate operations. These statements are not negative operational findings.

material_claims.claim: S003 fully determines the on-disk contract; referenced Zarr features and actual reader behavior remain unbounded or unevidenced.
material_claims.rationale: Detailed OME metadata rules are captured, but complete Zarr-v3 mechanics and binary transform encoding are referenced rather than fully specified. The later source-gap caveats receive credit.

material_claims.claim: The plan’s core is compatible, but detailed discovery, axes, transforms, defaults, labels and metadata validation need refinement.
material_claims.rationale: Core fit and many refinements are supported. Optional metadata and recommendations do not automatically impose every proposed display obligation; disputed refinements are assessed separately.

material_claims.claim: Zarr-v3 features are allowed unless disallowed; no disallowance anywhere, so backend unsupported inputs need graceful feedback.
material_claims.rationale: No particular codec/grid profile is imposed. Blanket absence of restrictions must preserve image-rank/order and integer-label constraints. Feature permission is not universal reader support.

material_claims.claim: Local reading, unchanged files, session-local settings and explicit non-goals are compatible product boundaries.
material_claims.rationale: Storage location is general, but this brief narrows capability. No obligatory writeback follows from the format; read-only remains an explicit product requirement.

material_claims.claim: Read zarr.json attributes.ome and string version; consistency gates the hierarchy; only 0.5 is in contract, others visibly best-effort or rejected.
material_claims.rationale: Explicit layout/version admission and truthful unsupported or malformed feedback are provided. A best-effort open must retain its caveat rather than claim verified conformance.

material_claims.claim: Transitional readers MUST/SHOULD read data, writers usually MAY; examples and notes excepted, JSON comments forbidden.
material_claims.rationale: JSON/comment and example exceptions are accurate. Source says implementations may be expected or encouraged to support reading, not a blanket mandate to implement every transitional feature.

material_claims.claim: Read exact legacy exception spellings rather than normalize them to camelCase.
material_claims.rationale: Specification naming recommendation does not alter literal field_count, label-value, maximumfieldcount, timestamps or namespaced layout keys.

material_claims.claim: Images are groups and pyramid levels are independently described Zarr arrays; Zarr-v3 decoding is a feature dependency.
material_claims.rationale: Correct node/metadata/chunk relationship. Reader capability may be bounded with an explicit explanation.

material_claims.claim: Distinguish plain image, HCS and bioformats2raw structures; plate takes precedence, then collection/image recognition, with ambiguity feedback.
material_claims.rationale: The structures and plate precedence are source-backed; the sniffing algorithm is a sound product proposal rather than the only universally mandated algorithm.

material_claims.claim: Name/first fallback is the only stated deterministic rule and a required addition, though its force is uncertain and adopted as an assumption.
material_claims.rationale: Adoption as an explicit product policy is valid. The source also suggests choosing by chunk size; illustrative selection advice does not establish an exclusive mandatory fallback or universal picker design.

material_claims.claim: Enumerate plate wells and their consistent row/column indices, well fields and acquisition identities; list every physical row/column even in sparse plates.
material_claims.rationale: Correct paths, hierarchy and conditional acquisition rules. A tree or qualified flat list can preserve identity.

material_claims.claim: The plan’s flat listing cannot express plate/well/acquisition identity.
material_claims.rationale: The plan leaves identity details unspecified; it does not prove a flat implementation incapable of qualified identities. The report appropriately leaves UI chrome as a product decision.

material_claims.claim: bioformats2raw value 3, optional series string paths/XML order, numbered fallback only without series/plate, optional recommended XML with MetadataOnly, and plate precedence.
material_claims.rationale: Conditions are mostly accurate and useful. The quoted value does not prove string-only JSON typing. XML is recommended, with OME-XML/MetadataOnly constraints when supplied.

material_claims.claim: Awareness of multiple images is SHOULD; showing all/choice/series use are MAY; plan acceptance treats awareness as required.
material_claims.rationale: Source force is quoted correctly in the recommendation paragraph, and stronger declared product acceptance is allowed. Minimum conforming behavior must not be restated as an unconditional MUST from a SHOULD.

material_claims.claim: Label contents MUST NOT appear as primary images; exclude label subtrees and expose them only as overlays.
material_claims.rationale: The labels group is not an image, but it explicitly contains label images implementing multiscales. The source does not prohibit standalone or primary-list presentation. Overlay-only listing is a product policy.

material_claims.claim: Alphanumeric unique case-sensitive row/column/field names must be resolved without case folding.
material_claims.rationale: Correct source identity constraints and sound path-resolution implication; avoiding case-insensitive collisions is a recommendation rather than a new case-folding rule.

material_claims.claim: Rows have no metadata section, so scanning directories alone is always non-conforming discovery.
material_claims.rationale: Plate/well declarations determine valid relationships. The source does not prohibit directory scanning to discover candidates followed by validation; it constrains the resulting metadata, not every internal algorithm.

material_claims.claim: IDs unique nonnegative integers; acquisition name/maxfieldcount and plate hints recommended; optional description/timestamps typed; identify fields by well/acquisition/path.
material_claims.rationale: Correct presence and type conditions. Tuple identity is useful engineering design; count hints do not replace actual field enumeration.

material_claims.claim: Source SHOULD fields imply that pyramid/plate/acquisition/well metadata should be surfaced in the viewer.
material_claims.rationale: Source SHOULD mainly recommends file-field presence and types, rather than universal reader UI display. Surfacing available hints is a valid product recommendation if identified as such.

material_claims.claim: Require field acquisition only when plate.acquisitions has more than one entry; honor supplied IDs and reject dangling references.
material_claims.rationale: Dangling-reference validation is source-backed. The actual trigger is multiple acquisitions performed; list length is a disclosed heuristic and cannot redefine normative validity in ambiguous or incomplete metadata.

material_claims.claim: Resolve arbitrary group-relative datasets paths in declared highest-resolution-to-smallest order, with rank/order/axes and dimension_names checks.
material_claims.rationale: Metadata, not numeric folder names or lexicographic order, controls level identity. Per-level mismatches receive explicit skip/refusal feedback rather than silent remapping.

material_claims.claim: Keep view-level selection and pan/zoom; add declared traversal, calibration, multiple-pyramid policy and per-level undecodable feedback.
material_claims.rationale: Most refinements follow correctness and responsiveness. A specific first-fallback picker remains policy. Missing/undecodable levels are explicitly item-scoped; no whole-image crash is assumed.

material_claims.claim: Largest-to-smallest has no metric; use total voxel count as a sanity check without reordering.
material_claims.rationale: Source gives highest-resolution as the meaning of largest, although no scalar metric is fixed. Total voxel count can misclassify anisotropic/nonuniform data; it is a disclosed heuristic, not a conformance oracle.

material_claims.claim: Chunked multi-GB-capable arrays indirectly require background/cancellation architecture and responsive navigation.
material_claims.rationale: Responsiveness and cancellation are product requirements. Multi-GB size and architecture necessity are engineering inferences, not measured source or reader-implementation facts; mechanism remains a product decision.

material_claims.claim: Malformed metadata, missing declared paths, transforms, HCS references and label violations are separated from undecodable backend features, with item feedback and alternatives.
material_claims.rationale: This is substantial correct refinement. Numeric window restrictions and optional label-version existence elsewhere are not proven malformed-input rules. A capability limit must keep its own classification.

material_claims.claim: Rank 2–5, two/three space axes, optional time and channel/null/custom, ordering, unique arbitrary names and array dimension_names determine identity.
material_claims.rationale: Correct mandatory identity conditions and array-level dimension_names placement; history wording does not justify a second compulsory axes field.

material_claims.claim: Controls follow declared axes; absent time/channel and two-space images hide irrelevant controls; plane uses two innermost spatial axes.
material_claims.rationale: Axis-driven controls are sound. The source only recommends a stated anisotropic zyx case, so fixed innermost-plane orientation is product policy. Present singleton versus absent image-axis slicing remains unspecified.

material_claims.claim: Missing/null/custom types and unknown units must be tolerated, with literal unknown-unit caveat and labeled positional inference.
material_claims.rationale: Optional metadata and custom types do not universally mandate that every reader render them; explicit capability refusal is permitted and appears later. Positional inference cannot establish validated semantic roles or physical calibration.

material_claims.claim: Omero is optional; if supplied channels, six-hex color and min/max/start/end windows are required; active/coefficient/rdefs etc appear in an example.
material_claims.rationale: Correct conditional field contract. Example-only fields are not guaranteed requirements.

material_claims.claim: Required file color/window fields impose mandatory initial color/contrast rendering; example defaults used best-effort.
material_claims.rationale: Required metadata fields constrain the file. They do not alone impose this precise universal reader initialization or contrast formula. Declared product defaults are legitimate, but the MUST rendering attribution is unsupported.

material_claims.claim: Channel-list size equality is comment-only; explicit overlap/default degradation, absent-omero fallback and best-effort rdefs are product choices.
material_claims.rationale: Correct separation of example comments from normative size rules; disclosed fallback avoids invented guaranteed defaults.

material_claims.claim: No out-of-range/window semantics are specified, but out-of-dtype values and start greater than end are malformed input.
material_claims.rationale: The report acknowledges the absent rule then invents one. Malformed six-digit color or missing required fields is distinct from an unsupported numeric display policy.

material_claims.claim: Ordered transforms applied sequentially; identity default, scale/translation with inline vectors or binary path.
material_claims.rationale: Correct general vocabulary and order. Image-specific lists have stricter scale/translation conditions.

material_claims.claim: Exactly one scale, optional one following translation, axis-length vectors, physical scaling or relative fallback when unavailable/inapplicable.
material_claims.rationale: Correct conditional scale semantics and malformed transform constraints. The optional group chain follows these same restrictions.

material_claims.claim: Group transforms are applied after dataset transforms; applying dataset alone omits shared calibration.
material_claims.rationale: Correct outer-after-inner prose. A global identity or untouched axis need not change its coordinates; the worked time scale shows the practical dependency.

material_claims.claim: Physical coordinate is global(scale∘translate) ∘ perLevel(scale∘translate), applied in listed order.
material_claims.rationale: Standard function composition applies translate before scale in each written chain, opposite to the mandated scale-then-translation list. Correct prose does not remove the material equation conflict; an explicit numeric ordered algorithm is needed.

material_claims.claim: The worked calibration example is normative; level spatial scales 0.5/1/2 and shared 0.1 time scale give the shown voxel sizes.
material_claims.rationale: Numerical values and scale-only composition are correct, but examples are explicitly non-normative. Commuting scale-only values cannot expose reversed scale/translation order.

material_claims.claim: Display per-axis names/extents/units and the currently displayed level’s composed coordinates, calibration, path and pyramid identity.
material_claims.rationale: Useful source-grounded derived display policy consistent with the brief; private panel layout is not itself a normative format requirement.

material_claims.claim: Without unit, a scale necessarily is relative; channel axes never have meaningful physical scale.
material_claims.rationale: Unit absence does not prove relative versus unknown physical scale, and no categorical channel-calibration prohibition is stated. Retain unknown semantics without inventing a unit or a definitive relative interpretation.

material_claims.claim: Treat an undefined origin as the image-group frame and disclose that assumption.
material_claims.rationale: A disclosed local-frame policy is acceptable; it does not add an unstated absolute world origin or settle every association/calibration ambiguity.

material_claims.claim: Binary vector path encoding lacks full representation details; it is supported only if backend resolves it, otherwise named unsupported input.
material_claims.rationale: Valid path-form transforms are not format-invalid. This is an honest capability boundary rather than a fabricated source acquisition failure.

material_claims.claim: Resolve declared arbitrary label paths through metadata-free intermediate groups; complete listing SHOULD, optional scanning policy disclosed.
material_claims.rationale: Correct discovery and intermediate-group rules. A justified ignore/scan policy for SHOULD-unlisted labels does not imply all listed labels may be silently skipped.

material_claims.claim: Label images require multiscales, same level count as original, and specified signed/unsigned integer dtypes through 64 bits.
material_claims.rationale: Correct conditional label contract and per-overlay failure context. Dtype admission alone does not prove exact decode/lookup of all 64-bit values.

material_claims.claim: Use corresponding levels, singleton-axis broadcast and own transforms checked against parent; warn on mismatches rather than stretch.
material_claims.rationale: Geometry checks are useful. Usually qualifies dimensions/transforms, not an automatic exemption from same coordinate-system association. Equal level count and warnings do not validate the intended original-image reference.

material_claims.claim: Preserve categorical integer labels with nearest-neighbor rather than intensity interpolation.
material_claims.rationale: Sound explicit engineering inference from categorical identities. Sparse/wide ID lookup and supported numeric range remain unaddressed.

material_claims.claim: Image-label object recommended; colors and version with typed keys; version string MUST be present.
material_claims.rationale: Object and colors/version inclusion are SHOULD. The MUSTs govern colors-array and version-string types if present. Mandatory version-key existence is a force upgrade.

material_claims.claim: Color entries and properties keyed by integer label-value; optional rgba alpha, arbitrary extra keys, recommended color use, fallback palette/legend policy.
material_claims.rationale: Correct keyed metadata and source color recommendation. No array-position palette or mandatory fallback is inferred; exact wide-integer preservation still needs a range/decode policy.

material_claims.claim: Source.image relative reference defaults ../../ but is followed only for provenance, never to relocate an overlay.
material_claims.rationale: The reference identifies the original image. Resolve and validate it from the label-image location before associating an overlay, or visibly decline the unsupported association. Same geometry cannot prove intended image identity.

material_claims.claim: Extend label discovery/validation/alignment/rendering/messages; accept any string label version and use own geometry with parent comparison.
material_claims.rationale: The refinements are useful. A string-type vocabulary gap does not guarantee all future semantic versions readable. Required association is still omitted, and palette/legend display remains a product choice.

material_claims.claim: MUST inventory restates container, namespace, axes, levels, composition, HCS/collection, omero, labels and unchanged files.
material_claims.rationale: Most source conditions are correct, but item 8 makes reader rendering obligatory from conditional metadata fields. Product read-only scope is correctly attributed to brief/plan.

material_claims.claim: SHOULD inventory includes multiplicity, zyx, units, displayed metadata, XML, label colors, empty groups and private session-store camelCase.
material_claims.rationale: Several source SHOULDs concern writer field presence rather than reader display. The private-store naming rule is not in S003. Recommended colors and multiplicity force are correctly retained.

material_claims.claim: New viewer-private session keys SHOULD use camelCase under S003 naming conventions.
material_claims.rationale: The source limits this recommendation to keys in the specification. A private product naming convention may be inspired by it but is not a source obligation.

material_claims.claim: Optional omero, collection choices, global transforms, label metadata, acquisitions, custom types and backend features are product-controlled.
material_claims.rationale: Accurate conditional/optional inventory; once optional fields are supplied their specified types and relationships still apply.

material_claims.claim: UI chrome, level heuristic, caching/cancellation, absent defaults, fallback palette, scan policy, capability/refusal and performance budgets need explicit product review.
material_claims.rationale: These choices are substantially unstated by format and fit the plan’s explicit capability-review boundary. They must preserve truthful calibration and association.

material_claims.claim: Extend opening/discovery and keep pan/zoom conditioned on calibrated levels.
material_claims.rationale: Hierarchy/version/discovery/calibration refinement is supported. Mandatory label-subtree exclusion is an unsupported source-attributed policy.

material_claims.claim: Extend axis controls, omero-aware initialization, label support and composed details.
material_claims.rationale: Useful changes are justified as product/correctness refinements. Universal omero initialization, optional metadata display and provenance-only label association cannot be validated by this blanket disposition.

material_claims.claim: Keep/constrain level choice to metadata authority and explicit heuristic; keep responsive cancellation and extend named failures.
material_claims.rationale: Metadata authority and product responsiveness are sound. Source data scale does not mandate one architecture, and the malformed catalog must exclude invented numeric-window/optional-key rules.

material_claims.claim: Keep non-goals/read-only and raise acceptance to the extended behaviors, all source-derived.
material_claims.rationale: Keep dispositions are correct. The raised product bar may be valid, but not every extended behavior is a source obligation and association/categorical/calibration gaps remain.

material_claims.claim: Valid but undisplayable backend/path/custom metadata, malformed source structures and product-out-of-scope inputs receive item-scoped explanations.
material_claims.rationale: The three-way distinction is strong. OME-XML beyond MetadataOnly correspondence is an extra product choice, not an explicit brief non-goal. An image-label version omission and unproved numeric windows cannot become format violations.

material_claims.claim: Normative array dimension_names wording conflicts with history; follow array placement; validator behavior unresolved.
material_claims.rationale: Correct source adjudication and honest external validator uncertainty.

material_claims.claim: Null/custom allowance versus type-string recommendation motivates lenient reading.
material_claims.rationale: Textual tension is visible, but a SHOULD string is not a MUST-string contradiction. Lenient typed-axis policy is valid if uncertain roles stay labeled.

material_claims.claim: No ordering metric is stated and voxel-count check is adopted without reordering.
material_claims.rationale: Highest-resolution gloss is present; no scalar metric is fixed. A disclosed check may not certify source violations.

material_claims.claim: Scale 1 is ambiguous without physical context; pair units and assume disclosed image-group origin.
material_claims.rationale: The ambiguity and origin limits are real. Unit absence cannot settle relative versus unknown physical scaling; definitive classification elsewhere is unsupported.

material_claims.claim: Global is outer after per-level; source’s worked shared calibration is scale-only/time.
material_claims.rationale: Correct limitation and prose. No translation-bearing expected output is supplied to resolve the conflicting equation.

material_claims.claim: Keyword-free multiscale fallback is implemented as the only stated rule.
material_claims.rationale: Declared policy is permitted; absence of RFC keywords alone does not make all prose informative. Pseudocode’s alternative chunk-size choice defeats exclusivity.

material_claims.claim: List length is comment-only; rdefs example-only; window semantics/out-of-range rule absent.
material_claims.rationale: Correct source uncertainty, which directly conflicts with the earlier automatic malformed numeric-window classification.

material_claims.claim: Usually/alignment and overview broadcasting leave parent/label transform precedence unresolved.
material_claims.rationale: Qualifiers and illustration are acknowledged. Label own multiscales geometry and source identity still require validation; usually does not erase same-coordinate-system meaning.

material_claims.claim: Label/plate/well version vocabularies unspecified; accept and display strings.
material_claims.rationale: Vocabulary gap is real. Acceptance is a capability policy; field-presence force differs: plate required, well/image-label recommended.

material_claims.claim: Layout value meaning unexplained; value 3 accepted; multiple-acquisition trigger implemented as greater-than-one entry.
material_claims.rationale: Literal value condition is clear despite missing historical rationale. Performed-acquisition trigger remains distinct from a metadata list-length heuristic.

material_claims.claim: Binary path lacks representation rules and is declined as unsupported.
material_claims.rationale: Honest valid-format capability limit, not a source violation.

material_claims.claim: Field-count versus maximumfieldcount semantics overlap; display hints only; duplicated by-the wording immaterial.
material_claims.rationale: Correctly avoids enumeration by maxima. Plate-wide versus per-acquisition hints are not proven interchangeable; typo has no material force.

material_claims.claim: Zarr profile unrestricted by reference; no actual reader tolerance, distribution or performance evidence; Tools pointer supplies no implementation requirements.
material_claims.rationale: Correct source-limited evidence gap. Format does contain reader recommendations, but no empirical implementation catalog or execution behavior.

material_claims.claim: Actual reader-interoperability goal cannot be met from S003 alone; future real filesets/code needed, without inventing implementation requirements or incompatibility.
material_claims.rationale: Correct scope limitation. Actual no-fetch authorization and probeable corpus operations remain unknown; known evaluator source gap is not candidate operational failure.

material_claims.claim: Unexecuted single-image version/axes/dimension_names/order and composed example voxel checks.
material_claims.rationale: Valid proposal; the scale-only worked example cannot detect order reversal or missing offsets. Unexecuted status is not a false test-result claim.

material_claims.claim: Unexecuted sparse/dense HCS paths, indices, fields and acquisition-qualified selection.
material_claims.rationale: Useful proposed reference/discovery validation; no actual pass claimed.

material_claims.claim: Unexecuted collection branches, plate precedence, XML order and multiplicity.
material_claims.rationale: Source conditions align; the product may adopt awareness as stronger acceptance while preserving SHOULD provenance.

material_claims.claim: Unexecuted ranks/untyped axes/control presence and omero mismatch degradation.
material_claims.rationale: Useful proposal, but singleton versus absent image axes is missing and guessed roles are not proven calibrated semantics.

material_claims.claim: Unexecuted coordinate checks at every level including unknown calibration and translation.
material_claims.rationale: The proposal is relevant but lacks a numeric offset-bearing expected oracle that would resolve the equation’s reversed inner chain.

material_claims.claim: Unexecuted intermediate labels, singleton broadcasting, alpha, palette, properties, mismatch and dtype/count gating.
material_claims.rationale: Useful geometry/display checks; no explicit/default source-reference association test or exact sparse/wide-ID range check is given.

material_claims.claim: Unexecuted all malformed cases with feedback, no crash and alternate selection.
material_claims.rationale: Valid product test goal; invented numeric window or optional version-key invalidity must not be encoded as source-conformance expectations.

## 12. Independent verification record and corpus scope (treatment session 2026-10-01)

Every seed section U001-U012 was independently re-verified against the full source corpus in this session before confirmation; all twelve are confirmed and none required amendment.

- Full reads (bounded tools only): `inputs/sources/S003.txt` (all 896 lines, sha256 `5d8b240877ed2cf9596566187bcb3779ea011d5319807134c65e2e7dc2ae82de`), `inputs/brief.md` (5 lines), `inputs/plan/Viewer.md` (11 lines), `inputs/candidate_seed.json` (all 58 lines, read as two calls whose union covers the file), `inputs/seed_block_hashes.json` (14 lines), `TASK.md` (7 lines). Complete hashes are recorded in `out/acquisition/V001.json`.
- Every S003 line locator cited by the seed was re-checked against the capture and resolves to the claimed content, including the textual tensions the seed itself reports: normative `dimension_names` wording at L174 versus the history one-liner at L827; `null / custom` axis type at L301 versus string-only types at L169; the comment-only channel-length note at L403; the alignment 'usually' hedge at L433; and the duplicated 'by the' at L93-L94.
- Corpus scope: `S003.txt` is the only source file in evidence. Probes of `inputs/sources/S000.txt`, `S001.txt`, `S002.txt` and `S004.txt`, and of candidate assignment/task/case paths under `inputs/`, each returned file-not-found from the bounded reader; directory enumeration was unavailable (mechanical line-map failed at the tool boundary on `.` and `inputs`), so corpus completeness beyond these named probes cannot be asserted - this is a tool-boundary limit, not a positive claim that no other sources exist.
- No live fetch, no code execution, and no writes inside `inputs/` occurred; all proposed validation in section 10 remains UNEXECUTED.
- Consequence: the unresolved areas remain exactly those recorded in sections 7-9 (U008-U010); the brief's real-reader-implementation research goal stays unresolvable inside this corpus (S003 L813-L814 pointer only).
